items.title: Trump banking on ‘swift end’ of Iran war to bring down fuel prices
items.description: • Pezeshkian decries US blockade, insists ‘military force’ will not compel Tehran into submission • Washington weighs using ‘Mother Of All Bombs’ against Iranian energy sites, CNN reports WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump once again predicted a swift end to the war with Iran, and a sharp drop in oil prices once the conflict concludes, even as Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian warned that military action cannot force them into submission. “The Iran war will end very soon … Soon, as they want it to end,” Trump told reporters in Montana. “They’ll never have a nuclear weapon, and oil prices will drop like a rock.” According to Anadolu Agency , Trump also expressed uncertainty over which Ira­nian officials the US was negotiating with. “They don’t have a navy. They don’t have an air force. Their army is decimated. Their leaders are gone,” Trump said. “I should have probably left their leaders because I don’t know who the hell we’re negotiating with.” “Iran was the bully of the Middle East,” he said, adding that the country was no longer as powerful as it had been. Trump also claimed that US strikes had destroyed Iran’s naval fleet and rendered its military aircraft unusable. He said Iran had 159 ships and asserted that none remained operational, while also claiming that its fighter jets had been destroyed on the country’s runways. ‘Iran won’t submit to force’ Meanwhile in Tehran, President Pezeshkian warned that military action cannot force a country into submission, adding that his country “must find a way to strengthen national cohesion and unity”, Al Jazeera reported. He said that the country was facing its most intense blockade since the 1979 Revolution, accusing the United States of seeking to provoke public protests. “Over the 48 years since the Revolution, we have never faced such intense blockade, war and difficulties as we are facing now,” Pezeshkian said in a speech broadcast by state television. He accused Washington of seeking to make life difficult for Iranians to fuel public anger and trigger unrest. Pezeshkian said the US was focusing its efforts on making “the people become upset and face difficulties, and then for social protests to emerge so that they can achieve their sinister objectives”. ‘Mother Of All Bombs’ Meanwhile, the US is considering using the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB) bomb — better known by its nickname, the “Mother Of All Bombs” — against Iran if Trump decides to renew combat in the deadlocked war, CNN reported on Thursday. The military is planning for the potential use of the weapon to target Iranian energy infrastructure and nuclear sites, according to the news outlet, which quoted officials familiar with the matter. “The MOAB is a massive information operation type weapon that is great for huge area clearance but not much else,” a source familiar with the plans told CNN. “It is definitely not designed as a deep penetration warhead.” Trump is trying to boost his low approval ratings ahead of November’s midterm elections , with polls showing the unpopular war in Iran and the fuel and other price rises it has caused are hurting his Republican Party. Diplomatic efforts to end the conflict have been at an impasse since the summer, and Washington has in recent weeks dialled back military operations in favour of economic pressure. However, officials have raised doubts over the efficacy of the bomb if deployed, particularly its ability to destroy suspected underground nuclear sites in Iran, as well as concerns over possible civilian casualties from such a huge weapon. Published in Dawn, October 16th, 2026

items.title: Saudi organisers say 2027 Asian Cup 'on schedule' after attacks
items.description: The Asian Cup in January is "on schedule", Saudi Arabian organisers said, after growing fears for the tournament following Houthi attacks on the country. The continent's top football official said this week that the competition could be postponed to 2028, while stressing there was "no hurry" to make a decision. The 2027 Asian Cup is supposed to kick off on January 7 in the Saudi cities of Jeddah, Riyadh and Al Khobar.

items.title: AJK assembly speaker calls for consensus on future of refugee seats
items.description: MUZAFFARABAD: Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) Legislative Assembly Speaker Chaudhry Tariq Farooq has called for a broad-based consensus on the future of refugee seats in the assembly, urging political leaders to help resolve the current crisis through dialogue and reforms. Speaking to journalists at the Speaker House on Thursday, Mr Fa­­rooq said political leaders had an opportunity to align themselves with national objectives and provide guidance by finding a way forward rather than dwelling on the past. “Learning from mistakes is wisdom. We need to explore new avenues for the future,” he said, adding that he supported reforms in all institutions. AJK could not progress with its large administrative structure and high expenditure, he said, while maintaining that the newly elected government, comprising young people, should be given an opportunity to move in the right direction. Backs institutional reforms, says electricity and flour subsidies will continue He also said subsidies on electricity and flour would not be withdrawn, though relief and concessions should be targeted on the basis of data. Distinguishing between constitutional offices and the executive, he claimed that although power was influential, the assembly speaker was not part of the government, just as the state president was not. “The assembly is not the government; the cabinet and the prime minister constitute the government,” he said. The government had been in office for only a few weeks, and the second phase of cabinet formation was still pending. It would be completed upon the return of PML-N supremo Nawaz Sharif to Pakistan, he said. Mr Farooq said the government and cabinet had not been expanded because elections in seven constituencies of Poonch division were still pending. Without representation from these areas, he added, the government could not be considered complete and fully functional. Poonch situation Mr Farooq said informal negotiations were under way through the AJK president to improve law and order and ease tensions in Poonch. He expressed the hope that backchannel contacts would produce positive results and urged the media to avoid speculation until the talks yielded an outcome. He accused the PPP of attempting to exploit the Poonch situation for political gain during its brief stint in power, adding that the phased elections had been held with the party’s consent. The speaker said the state president and the entire political leadership should come forward to find solutions through dialogue. Political parties and their leaders had a responsibility to play an effective role, he said, adding that the process of rendering them irrelevant and ineffective had begun during the previous assembly. Mr Farooq recalled that he and some other PML-N leaders had called for a fact-finding commission a year ago to examine the circumstances contributing to the current situation, but no political party had supported the proposal. Published in Dawn, October 16th, 2026

items.title: PTA shares tips to improve calls, internet quality
items.description: • Urges users to turn on 4G/LTE, VoLTE settings on their phones • Consumers with older SIM cards told to upgrade for 4G support ISLAMABAD: The Pak­i­stan Telecommu­nica­tion Authority (PTA) adv­ised mobile phone users on Thursday to adjust their network settings and adopt newer technologies, including Voice over Long-Term Evolution (VoLTE), Wi-Fi Calling, and VoWiFi, to improve their calling and mobile internet experience. Responding to consumer complaints regarding unclear voice quality and connection delays on 4G and LTE calls, the telecom regulator recommended that users verify their handset network settings and activate the 4G/LTE option if it is not already switched on. The authority urged consumers to enable VoLTE, Wi-Fi Calling and VoWiFi options on their phones, noting that the availability and use of these facilities depend on compatibility between the handset and the relevant mobile operator. The guidance is primarily relevant to regions where 4G service is expanding following a recent spectrum auction. According to the regulator, VoLTE enables voice calls over a 4G network, which improves voice quality and speeds up call connections. To benefit from the facility, however, the handset, the SIM card and the mobile operator must all support the technology. For areas where mobile signals are weak, such as inside homes or in basements, the authority said Wi-Fi Calling and VoWiFi could be particularly useful. VoWiFi technology makes Wi-Fi Calling work, allowing users to place calls over a Wi-Fi connection provided their handset and operator support the feature. Users must enable the Wi-Fi Calling option in their phone settings and connect to a Wi-Fi network. Consumers must also ensure that both their phone and SIM support 4G services. Because many older SIM cards do not support 4G or VoLTE, the regulator suggested that users upgrade their SIMs. The 4G/LTE standard is the fourth-generation mobile network technology which offers faster mobile internet speeds than 3G. Published in Dawn, October 16th, 2026

items.title: Judicial commission on Mir Raza’s murder hands over sealed report to Sindh govt
items.description: KARACHI: A sealed report prepared by the judicial commission formed to investigate the circumstances and possible negligence in Mir Raza Ali’s murder investigation was handed over to the provincial government on Thursday. The commission, headed by Justice Omar Sial of the Sindh High Court, concluded its proceedings last week after examining 49 witnesses during 15 hearings, including inspection of the crime scene. The inquiry report along with associated documents was handed over to focal person of the provincial government and additional secretary of home department Javed Ahmed Abro by registrar of the commission Abdul Majid on the premises of the SHC. As Justice Sial was hearing cases at the SHC Hyderabad circuit court, the registrar of the commission handed over the sealed report along with the entire record of the proceedings to the provincial authorities. It’s up to provincial authorities whether to make the document public or keep it secret, says official According to a communication sent by registrar Abdul Majid to the chief minister of Sindh through the focal person, since Justice Sial has been sitting at SHC Hyderabad pursuant to the roster commencing from Oct 12, the registrar has handed over the sealed report to the focal person along with executive summary, statements of witnesses and other supplementary documents. After receiving the record, Mr Abro told reporters that he would hand over the sealed report along with other record to the provincial government and it was the prerogative of the government to decide whether the inquiry report was to be brought into the public domain or otherwise. In August the provincial government formed the commission, which was tasked with making recommendations for further investigation and forensic analysis or legal/departmental action and it was required to submit its findings and recommendations to the Sindh government within 30 days. However, the commission had struggled to meet its deadline and sent an application last month to the Sindh government for an extension in its tenure till Oct 15. Therefore, the provincial cabinet granted an extension. Besides examining 49 witnesses and available record, the commission had also sent questionnaires to Karachi police chief Azad Khan, head of current investigation team DIG Amir Farooqui and DIG East Farrukh Lanjar after dismissing an application of aggrieved family to summon the senior police officers to testify before the commission. Therefore, the three police officers had submitted written answers before the commission through a commissioner appointed by the commission. The 25-year-old businessman and Institute of Business Administration graduate, Mir Raza Ali, had gone missing on July 28 after leaving his home in PECHS and his body with gunshot wounds was found a day later in bushes in a Gulistan-i-Jauhar’s locality. Initially, the police built the case around suicide on the basis of the first autopsy, which indicated a bullet entry wound on the chest, and by pointing out business losses and money borrowed by the victim. However, police surgeon Dr Summaiya Syed had disputed the findings of the first post-mortem conducted by medico-legal officer Dr Osama Sheikh. Published in Dawn, October 16th, 2026

items.title: Textile exports rise
items.description: ISLAMABAD: Pakis­tan’s textile and clothing exports rose 5.26 per cent to $5.026 billion in the first quarter of 2026-27 from $4.775bn in the same period last year. The marginal rise in export proceeds was attributed to elevated input costs, which eroded exporters’ competitiveness, and external shocks that disrupted shipments, according to data from the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics released on Thursday. Textile exporters have already warned the government that exports could slow further in the second quarter if no corrective measures are taken. Two major setbacks mainly contributed to slowing exports — suspension of trade with Afghanistan since October 2025 and falling exports to the Middle East due to the prevailing war in the region, especially the United Arab Emirates. PBS data showed readymade garment exports surged 15.69pc in value and 17.38pc in quantity during July-September FY27, while knitwear rose 4.14pc in value but fell 0.46pc in quantity. By contrast, bedwear dipped 0.07pc in value and 0.71pc in quantity. Pakistan’s oil import bill rose 6.50pc in 1QFY27 to $4.02bn from $3.77bn a year ago. Data showed import of crude oil jumped 23.10pc in value, with a decline of 6.87pc in quantity, indicating that the higher value of crude oil is due to rising international oil prices. Published in Dawn, October 16th, 2026

items.title: IHC seeks PTI response in case about Imran’s X account
items.description: ISLAMABAD: The Isla­mabad High Court (IHC) on Thursday granted PTI interim chairman Barris­ter Gohar Ali Khan additional time to submit a written response to a petition seeking a ban on party founder Imran Khan’s official X account, adjourning the hearing until Nov 23. Justice Arbab Muham­mad Tahir heard the petition, filed by Ghulam Mur­taza, while Barrister Gohar appeared in person. The court observed that Barrister Gohar could have submitted his response in writing. The PTI leader told the court his party did not cla­im ownership of the X ac­­c­ount in question. However, citing a change in circumstances, he sought additional time to submit a detailed response. Meanwhile, Judicial Magistrate Shaista Kundi issued arrest warrants for the accused who failed to appear in cases registered against the PTI founder and others in connection with the 2014 sit-in. Mr Khan could not be produced in court as he is currently incarcerated in Adiala jail. The magistrate then adjourned proceedings till Nov 25 and directed that evidence be presented at the next hearing. Published in Dawn, October 16th, 2026

items.title: Wang Yi urges Israel to open Gaza routes, halt West Bank settlements
items.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi on Thursday called for the full opening of access routes into Gaza to prevent a worsening humanitarian disaster and urged Israel to halt and reverse settlement activities in the West Bank. Wang, a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, made the remarks during a meeting with Israeli President Isaac Herzog in Baku on the sidelines of the Seventh Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA). China and Israel have maintained stable relations and achieved positive results in practical cooperation over the past three decades, Wang said. He expressed China's willingness to use the 35th anniversary of diplomatic relations next year as an opportunity to deepen cooperation and strengthen public support for bilateral ties. He stressed that the Palestinian question is the greatest historical injustice of the 21st century and that the two-state solution is the right path to resolving it. China stands ready to work with the international community to bring all parties back to dialogue and negotiations and seek a political solution to the conflict, Wang said, adding that both Palestinians and Israelis have the right to live in peace and to establish independent states. Herzog said Israel firmly adheres to the one-China policy and hopes to advance friendly ties with China, including cooperation in science and technology, investment and people-to-people exchanges. He said Israel hopes for peace but faces threats and challenges to its national security that require a strong response. Herzog also praised China's efforts to promote regional peace and stability, saying Israel values China's proposals and initiatives and is willing to maintain communication with Beijing.

items.title: China says Israel should stop its 'forced establishment' of West Bank settlements
items.description: BEIJING, Oct 16 (Reuters) - Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi has told Israeli President Isaac Herzog that Israel should stop and reverse its "forced establishment" of West Bank settlements. China has consistently held that the Palestinian question is the greatest historical injustice of this century, Wang told Herzog during a meeting in Azerbaijan, according to a statement by the Chinese foreign ministry on Friday.

items.title: EU summit focuses on competitiveness, energy prices
items.description: European Union (EU) leaders gathered in Brussels on Thursday for a two-day summit which focused on economic competitiveness, high energy prices and the bloc's next long-term budget, with the first day ending amid differences in views and the cancellation of a scheduled press conference. According to the European Council's agenda, economic challenges take center stage, with EU leaders expected to provide guidance to the European Commission on targeted, temporary short-term measures to ease the impact of high energy prices on businesses and households. They will also discuss longer-term efforts to reduce Europe's dependence on fossil fuels. A recent surge in energy prices has heightened concerns over the EU's competitiveness. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen recently told the European Parliament that natural gas prices in Europe had risen by 140% since late February, while diesel prices had doubled, adding around 100 billion euros (about $112.1 billion) to the bloc's fossil fuel import bill. With winter approaching, high energy costs could place further strain on European industries and households. The EU's next long-term budget is another major item on the agenda. Leaders will continue discussions on the Multiannual Financial Framework for 2028-2034, seeking to consolidate key elements needed to reach a final agreement by the end of 2026. The summit will also address continued support for Ukraine, including its critical infrastructure needs ahead of winter, as well as European security and defense, migration, EU enlargement and the situation in the Middle East.

items.title: Lula recorta a dos puntos la ventaja de Flávio Bolsonaro, pero siguen en empate técnico a poco más de una semana de la elección
items.description: Avanza el calendario, ya queda poco más una semana para las elecciones más reñidas de Brasil, pero la foto es, prácticamente, la misma de los últimos meses: un férreo empate técnico. La encuesta Datafolha divulgada este jueves muestra un ligero avance del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva , que recorta de cuatro a dos puntos la ventaja que le lleva Flávio Bolsonaro, el favorito. El senador ultraderechista logra un 51% de los votos válidos frente al 49% del presidente. Otra encuesta, la de Quaest, mostró la víspera la misma foto con otros números: 47% frente a 45%. La campaña de Lula acusa a la tecnológica Meta de favorecer a Bolsonaro tanto en WhatsApp como en Instagram. Seguir leyendo

items.title: Chinese FM holds talks with Azerbaijani counterpart
items.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks with Azerbaijani Foreign Minister Jeyhun Bayramov in Baku, Azerbaijan, on Thursday. Wang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee, said that in recent years, China-Azerbaijan relations have entered the fast track, achieved leapfrog development and reached their best period in history, opening up broad prospects for the future. The sound development of bilateral relations has benefited from the high level of mutual trust between leaders of the two countries and the strategic guarantee they provide, enabling the two sides to firmly support each other on issues concerning their respective core interests, continuously consolidate the political foundation of bilateral relations and create important conditions for strengthening cooperation, Wang said. As a long-term strategic partner, China will continue to support Azerbaijan in accelerating its development and revitalization, he added. China appreciates Azerbaijan's work during its chairmanship of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA) and supports Azerbaijan in playing a greater role within the CICA and in international affairs, Wang said. Noting that next year will mark the 35th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Azerbaijan, Wang said that China stands ready to work with Azerbaijan to implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, and take the anniversary as an opportunity to jointly accelerate their respective modernization drives and benefit the two peoples. For his part, Bayramov said Azerbaijan and China are sincere friends and reliable partners, with a long-standing friendship, increasingly close exchanges at all levels and bilateral relations reaching an unprecedented level. Azerbaijan firmly adheres to the one-China principle and stands ready to work with China, under the guidance of the two heads of state, to advance their comprehensive strategic partnership, strengthen cooperation in areas such as energy, transport, climate change, artificial intelligence, and people-to-people and cultural exchanges, and step up efforts in the Belt and Road cooperation and support to the Middle Corridor, Bayramov said. The two sides also had an in-depth exchange of views on advancing bilateral practical cooperation in the next phase and on international and regional issues of common concern.

items.title: Chinese FM puts forward four proposals on boosting CICA cooperation
items.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi put forward four proposals on boosting cooperation among member states of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA) on Thursday while attending the Seventh Summit of the CICA. Wang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, said that the CICA is a platform for dialogue and cooperation initiated and jointly built by Asian countries. Since its establishment, the CICA has actively championed the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence, systematically advanced cooperation on confidence building measures, consistently practiced multilateralism, and worked tirelessly to strengthen the foundation of trust for peace and security in Asia. China highly appreciates Azerbaijan's efforts during its CICA chairmanship to advance CICA cooperation, and stands ready to continue its strong support for and active participation in the CICA process, Wang said. Amid accelerating changes unseen in a century, only by fostering a sense of community with a shared future, standing on the right side of history, and upholding solidarity and cooperation can Asian countries stand at the forefront of the times, turn crises into opportunities and jointly create a better future, he said. Wang put forward four proposals: First, jointly safeguard peace and stability. Asia does not need a Cold War mentality and does not welcome bloc confrontation. Asia's problems should ultimately be addressed by the people of Asia through solidarity and cooperation, and Asia's security should be ensured by upholding the vision of common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security. Second, jointly promote prosperity and revitalization. Development is the master key to solving all problems. Efforts should be made to better align high-quality Belt and Road cooperation with the development initiatives of various countries, safeguard an open environment for cooperation, advance trade and investment liberalization and facilitation, ensure the stable and efficient operation of international transport corridors, and strengthen supply security for critical raw materials, energy resources and food, so that Asian countries can work together to accelerate their progress toward modernization. Third, jointly promote exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations. Asia is the continent with the greatest diversity of civilizations. Efforts should be made to firmly promote the Asian values of peace, cooperation, openness and inclusiveness, respect countries' independent choices of development paths and governance models, deepen exchanges and cooperation in culture, tourism and health, as well as among women's and youth groups, media organizations and think tanks, and promote people-to-people exchanges and closer bonds between peoples, so that diverse civilizations can learn from one another and flourish together. Fourth, jointly improve global governance. Efforts should be made to reinvigorate the authority and role of the United Nations, uphold the basic norms governing international relations established by the UN Charter, strengthen capacities in digital governance, disaster prevention and mitigation, and public health, and jointly build a more efficient, inclusive and resilient governance system in Asia. Wang stressed that China will remain firmly committed to the path of peaceful development, bring greater stability to the international landscape through its own high-quality development, and provide stronger impetus for global growth. China stands ready to work with all parties to build consensus, deepen cooperation and jointly build a peaceful, stable, prosperous, open and inclusive Asian community with a shared future, making greater Asian contribution to world peace and development, Wang said. Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev briefed attendees on the work undertaken by Azerbaijan during its two-year CICA chairmanship and put forward proposals for cooperation. Participants exchanged views on the security and development situation in the CICA region and the implementation of confidence building measures. They agreed that CICA member states should practice multilateralism, strengthen solidarity and cooperation, address common challenges, safeguard the common interests of the Global South, and promote peace and development in Asia. The summit adopted and issued the Baku Declaration of the Seventh CICA Summit. On the sidelines of the summit, Wang also met separately with Israeli President Isaac Herzog, Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, Bahraini Foreign Minister Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani, Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan and Palestinian Foreign Minister Varsen Aghabekian Shahin, and had friendly exchanges with dignitaries from various countries. (With input from Xinhua)

Chinese FM meets Russian counterpart in Azerbaijan
items.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi on Wednesday met with his Russian counterpart, Sergei Lavrov, in Baku, with both sides pledging to strengthen bilateral cooperation and coordination in multilateral frameworks. Wang, a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, congratulated Russia on the successful State Duma elections. Wang expressed confidence that the upcoming APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen in November would achieve fruitful results with support from Russia and other parties, injecting strong momentum into development and cooperation in the Asia-Pacific. He also called for closer cooperation among members of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA) to uphold genuine multilateralism and contribute to improving global governance. Lavrov said Russia-China relations and cooperation across various fields had continued to advance under the strategic guidance of the two countries' leaders, serving their fundamental interests. He reaffirmed Russia's full support for China's hosting of the APEC meeting and called for closer coordination within the United Nations, the Group of 20, APEC and BRICS to safeguard international fairness and justice. The two sides also coordinated positions on upcoming high-level exchanges and international and regional issues of mutual concern, reaching new common understandings.

items.title: Hydrocarbures : 7 sociétés internationales en concurrence pour l’approvisionnement de la Mauritanie
items.description: Sept entreprises internationales participent à l'appel d'offres pour l'approvisionnement de la Mauritanie en carburants, dont les offres ont commencé à être ouvertes jeudi par la Commission nationale des hydrocarbures. Parmi elles figurent trois sociétés classées parmi les plus grandes entreprises mondiales dans ce secteur, selon ce qu'a annoncé le ministère de l'Énergie. Dans un communiqué, le ministère a indiqué que l’appel d’offres attirait auparavant des entreprises de petite taille et à la présence régionale limitée, soulignant que la participation de ces sept entreprises internationales reflétait l’élargissement de la concurrence pour l’obtention du contrat d’approvisionnement. Il a ajouté que le secteur de l’énergie s’était efforcé d’améliorer les procédures d’appel d’offres et d’en renforcer l’attractivité auprès des entreprises internationales, sans toutefois fournir de détails sur les entreprises participantes, les quantités requises ni la valeur du contrat.

items.title: Mauritanie : gratuité du transport urbain pour près de 10.000 étudiants
items.description: Le ministère mauritanien de l'Enseignement supérieur et de la Recherche scientifique a annoncé que 9 926 étudiants inscrits au registre social de la Délégation générale pour la solidarité nationale et la lutte contre l'exclusion « Taazour » bénéficieront de la gratuité des transports urbains, dont 9 762 à Nouakchott et 164 à Nouadhibou. Dans un communiqué publié jeudi, le ministère a indiqué que les listes des étudiants concernés avaient été transmises à la délégation « Taazour » et à la société de transports publics, invitant les bénéficiaires à effectuer les démarches nécessaires pour obtenir leur abonnement. Il a ajouté que tous les étudiants de l’enseignement supérieur peuvent bénéficier de tarifs réduits sur le réseau universitaire traditionnel moyennant un abonnement mensuel de 5 000 anciennes ouguiyas, la carte d’abonnement pouvant être obtenue via l’application « E-Ticket » ou aux guichets de vente du campus universitaire. Le ministère a précisé que l’achat des billets à tarif réduit, dont le prix unitaire est de 50 anciennes ouguiyas, est désormais disponible exclusivement via l’application, soulignant que les étudiants qui ne l’utilisent pas devront payer le prix normal du billet. Le ministère a également annoncé la mise en service de bus du système de transport rapide « BHNS » sur des lignes urbaines desservant le campus universitaire, en réponse aux demandes des usagers.
